book.wisplight.grimoire.page1:
§lGrimoire of Glimmers§r

What the wisps taught me, night after night.

§8Read me before you go looking for them.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page2:
§lThe wisps§r

When night falls they wander: Azure in forests and plains, Emerald in swamps, Frost in the snow, Ember in the Nether.

They flee weapons and running.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page3:
§lCapture§r

Sneak up with an empty jar in hand (5 glass and a wooden slab). The wisp lets itself be caught.

Killing it only gives a little dust… and bad luck.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page4:
§lThe jar§r

A jarred wisp makes an essence every 5 minutes, twice as fast in its home biome. Collect it with a bottle.

Sneak with an empty hand to set it free.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page5:
§lLumen§r

This crystal glows in caves, between Y -48 and 32.

4 shards and 1 gold ingot make a lumen ingot: tools and armor between iron and diamond.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page6:
§lThe infusion altar§r

It needs a jarred wisp within 3 blocks.

Ingot + 2 essences: a charm.
Lumen gear + 2 matching essences: an infusion.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page7:
§lInfusions§r

§bLight§r: lights, reveals.
§aLife§r: heals, mends.
§6Fire§r: burns, smelts ores.
§fFrost§r: slows, freezes water.

One infusion per item.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page8:
§lShades§r

Shades are born in total darkness. They hunt wisps and steal essences.

Lumen hurts them twice as much. Their fragments forge the Watcher armor.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page9:
§lThe sanctuary§r

The Compass of Glimmers (compass + 4 essences) leads to the Forgotten Sanctuary.

Charge its 4 runestones, then at night offer a jarred wisp to the altar.
book.wisplight.grimoire.page10:
§lThe Hollow Warden§r

Destroy its orbs, beware the Shades. When its flame turns red and swells, hide behind a wall.

Its heart rekindles every lantern.
